title: CAMP: Context-Aware Mapping and Placement for LLMs on 3D-IMC Arrays
abstract: arXiv:2611.07707v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) incur severe memory-access overheads due to the cost of loading large weight matrices and key-value (KV) caches. Analog In-Memory Computing (AIMC) is an emerging solution that enables computation directly on static weights stored in memory, substantially reducing energy and latency. 3D-IMC further stacks memory arrays into vertical tiers, increasing capacity but revealing a new challenge: how weights are placed in memory determines which matrix-vector multiplications (MVMs) can execute concurrently, affecting latency and throughput. The concurrency aspect of 3D-IMC weight-mapping remains underexplored in the literature, leading to sub-optimal utilization of compute resources on 3D-IMC chips. In this context we propose CAMP (Context-Aware Mapping and Placement), an inference-context-aware weight mapping algorithm for 3D-IMC-based LLM accelerators. translated_title: CAMP：面向3D-IMC阵列上大语言模型的上下文感知映射与放置
translated_abstract: 大语言模型由于需要加载大型权重矩阵和键值（KV）缓存而产生严重的内存访问开销。模拟存内计算（AIMC）是一种新兴的解决方案，它能够直接在存储于内存中的静态权重上执行计算，从而大幅降低能耗和延迟。3D-IMC进一步将内存阵列堆叠成垂直层级，增加了容量，但也带来了新的挑战：权重在内存中的放置方式决定了哪些矩阵向量乘法（MVM）可以并发执行，进而影响延迟和吞吐量。3D-IMC权重映射的并发性问题在现有文献中仍未得到充分研究，导致3D-IMC芯片上计算资源的利用欠佳。在此背景下，我们提出了CAMP（上下文感知映射与放置），这是一种面向基于3D-IMC的LLM加速器的推理上下文感知权重映射算法。CAMP能够捕获由此产生的潜在资源争用……
tldr: 提出CAMP算法，通过感知LLM推理上下文来优化3D-IMC芯片上的权重映射与放置，提升矩阵向量乘法的并发执行能力和计算资源利用率。
en_tdlr: CAMP is an inference-context-aware weight mapping and placement algorithm for 3D-IMC-based LLM accelerators that optimizes the concurrency of matrix-vector multiplications to improve compute resource utilization, latency, and throughput.
